scope: GLB structure, accessor safety, skin bind/weights, seven clips, motion/loops, run/walk distinction and arm anatomy, held defeat pose, duplicate attacks, new character walk/victory individuality and PNG sheets

Attack.description: Ribbon rapier: measured fencing lunge and recovery
Crescent scythe: two-handed overhead reaping cut with inner edge leading
Azure wave: wide lateral trace followed by a flowing palm release
Tidal arc: overhead summoning circle and descending charm release
Rose pulse: two compact forward casts with a guarded free hand
Clover bloom: rising wand spiral and a small outward seed flick
Cat pounce: lead paw jab followed by a rear paw cross
Clockwork doll: alternating angular hand strikes with a ticking head
Peony fan: cross-body fan slice and outward wrist flourish
Snow crystal: gather with both hands, raise, then release symmetrically

Idle.description: Alert trailblazer: balanced low blades, a small scouting glance and breathing

Walk.description: Light adventurer steps with outward low blades, a forward lean and scouting head turns

Run.description: Quick trailblazer sprint with both blades kept outside the body and compact knee drive

Attack.description: Trailblazer daggers: left diagonal cut, right return cut and crossed recovery

Defend.description: daggers guard: enter, hold and recover

Victory.description: Confident dagger salute, a quick left-hand flourish and a satisfied nod

Lose.description: Grounded defeated crouch with lowered head and held finish

Idle.description: Cheerful fox: a swaying hip pose, shoulder-high star baton and playful head tilt

Walk.description: Buoyant fox steps with lifted toes, a swinging star baton and a jaunty free hand

Run.description: Bouncy fox dash with a high baton carry and a pumping free arm

Attack.description: Fox-star baton: buoyant wind-up, zigzag star trace and forward bell flick

Defend.description: fox_baton guard: enter, hold and recover

Victory.description: Two fox-ear hand beats, a side-to-side baton cheer and a little celebratory hop

Lose.description: Grounded defeated crouch with lowered head and held finish

Idle.description: Thoughtful flower witch: upright staff, free hand over the spell book and a quiet glance

Walk.description: Measured witch steps with an upright staff, restrained foot lift and gentle cape sway

Run.description: Purposeful witch dash with a stable upright staff and a free hand protecting the hat

Attack.description: Flower witch: staff traces a summoning arc while the free hand writes a spell

Defend.description: witch_staff guard: enter, hold and recover

Victory.description: A theatrical hat-tip, an outward spell-hand flourish and a courteous bow

Lose.description: Grounded defeated crouch with lowered head and held finish

Idle.description: Poised rose princess: bouquet close to the heart, a gentle head tilt and breathing

Walk.description: Small graceful barefoot steps with the bouquet held to the heart and the gown gathered aside

Run.description: Careful princess hurry with shortened strides, bouquet protected and the gown lifted aside

Attack.description: Rose blessing: cradle the bouquet, extend its flowers and sink into a gentle curtsy

Defend.description: bouquet guard: enter, hold and recover

Victory.description: A deep royal curtsy, a gracious bouquet presentation and a warm head tilt

Lose.description: Grounded defeated crouch with lowered head and held finish
